findings.description: Inocente Lopez (L8GW-R6Y) died on 22 September 1916 in the jurisdiction of Suchitoto, Cuscatlán, El Salvador, where his death was registered. The two index entries for this death disagree by one day (22 and 23 September 1916): either day, or September 1916 at month precision, satisfies this. A year-only 1916, a range reaching outside September 1916, or any 1906 date does not.
